scripts.ci: npm run build && npm run content:validate && npm run style:audit && npm test
scripts.content:validate: npm run content:manifest:check && tsc -p tools/content-validator/tsconfig.json && node tools/content-validator/dist/validate-content.js
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run content:validate && npm run source:audit && npm run unicode:filenames && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
